issues.title: Spot historical data provenance: previous versions, corrections and point-in-time reconstruction
issues.scope_note: Asks whether prior ZIP versions are retained/retrievable; exact first-publication and replacement timestamps; complete checksum/correction history; whether closed klines can change; REST/archive parity; and official point-in-time reconstruction guarantees.
issues.interpretation_limit: An open question with no maintainer response observed is not proof that prior versions do not exist. It means the requested historical-version guarantee was not established by this public issue at observation time.

issues.title: Monthly SPOT kline archives disagree with daily archives and API for 2020-12-21 and 2021-09-29

only_comment.scope_note: Reports independently reproduced monthly/daily/API disagreement on dates outside CP-0112 and additional cross-timeframe archive discrepancies for 2021 timestamps.

issues.interpretation_limit: This is contextual evidence of reported archive inconsistencies on different dates. It is not direct evidence for the CP-0112 seven target dates and the comment is not treated as an official maintainer resolution.

official_readme_context.note: The repository documents daily/monthly downloadable archive files and per-file CHECKSUM sidecars, and notes that archives may be updated when issues are found. This provides file-integrity/revision context, not an historical point-in-time version guarantee.
